name: Uranium, first four

sprites.name: Metalynx
sprites.note: Back redrawn at the front's scale and touched up by hand: outlines, flower spots, eye, stripes, claws, armor seams. The leg plating and tail blade are steel; the rest is matte.

sprites.name: Raptorch
sprites.note: Back redrawn at the front's scale and touched up. The tail flame glows.

sprites.name: Eletux
sprites.note: Back redrawn at the front's scale and touched up: eye, mouth, nostril, the lightning bolt's edge, the three bulbs. The four orbs glow and pulse; the body is sleek. Look at the back's eye, mouth and far hind foot.

sprites.name: Electruxo
sprites.note: Back redrawn at the front's scale and touched up: eye, brow streak, mouth, throat edge. The hide and belly are glossy. The head crest and lightning stripes glow and pulse; the sail on its back does not.

note: The first Uranium sprites in the Gen 5 layout: each back redrawn at the front's scale and touched up, then lit. Orchynx and Chyinmunk follow.
